_template: source-registry.json — copy to project-data/sources/ at project start
_instructions: Every source used by any agent MUST be registered here by the agent itself (not the EM). Use the next available SRC ID. URL is MANDATORY — hard rule. No URL = do not register. Never write placeholder URLs, 'TBD', empty strings, or internal references (except for interview/primary-research types, which may use 'internal://descriptor'). Cite sources inline in documents as (SRC001) at the point of the claim. Do NOT track used_in here.

sources.title: McKinsey Global Institute: EV Charging Infrastructure Report 2025
sources.bias_note: McKinsey may have consulting engagements in this sector — directionally credible, methodology transparent
key_data_points: European EV charging market: EUR 45B by 2030 (p. 12)

_reliability_scale.high: Peer-reviewed, government statistics, tier-1 consulting/research firm with disclosed methodology
_reliability_scale.medium: Reputable news outlets (FT, WSJ, Bloomberg), industry associations, non-peer-reviewed research
_reliability_scale.low: Trade press, blog posts, single uncorroborated claim, outdated data (>5 years)

_download_note: Set downloaded: true and populate local_path when a file is saved locally. PDFs go to project-data/sources/documents/, HTML to project-data/sources/web/. Agents may download during research if they need to read the file; otherwise use /mct:download-sources.
